taste:
Expect smoky, tangy heat and a contrast between juicy chicken and crisp, charred skin. The half chicken is thoroughly marinated in spicy peri-peri sauce before roasting, so the seasoning is part of the meat’s flavour rather than just a finishing touch. This is a bold chicken dish, with a pronounced kick rather than a gently seasoned profile.

Golden chips and creamy coleslaw complete the plate. The chips sit alongside the strongly flavoured chicken, while the coleslaw provides a cooling contrast between mouthfuls. If you enjoy smoky notes as well as chilli heat, the marinade is the main reason to choose it. Diners looking for mild seasoning should consider another option.
